scope: All eight frozen citation claims, all five ordinary body-flow keys, primary-record metadata, exact nearby source support, active-library relevance, natural non-library coverage, and final LaTeX/BibTeX/AUX consistency were checked. No novelty or priority claim beyond the inspected sources is certified.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill search verification: freeze the complete claim/citation extraction first, then sequentially run fresh primary-source searches and inspect the exact official records and full-text locators for every retained key. The bib-reference-audit consistency checker, final AUX, BLG, and converged LaTeX log were checked separately. No manuscript or bibliography source edit was needed. Sub-agents were not used because the user explicitly prohibited them.
